claims.text: Ben-Gvir 14 Jan 2025 (X): 'In the past year, through our political strength, we succeeded in preventing such a deal from being made, time and again'; called pending deal 'terrible'; Lapid: shows Netanyahu blocked releases for political reasons; Netanyahu had rejected such claims; Blinken said Hamas repeatedly failed to conclude deals.

Ben-Gvir: Kach youth coordinator; convicted of incitement to racism and support for a terrorist organization; kept a photo of Baruch Goldstein until 2019/2020; in 1995 on TV with Rabin's car emblem: 'We got to his car, and we'll get to him too'; party rejoined government 18 March 2025.

Netanyahu sought Otzma joint list in Feb 2019 (AIPAC called Otzma 'racist and reprehensible'); Feb 2021 joint list with Religious Zionist Party 'orchestrated by' Netanyahu brought Ben-Gvir into the Knesset; 2022 Netanyahu urged reunification.
25 Nov 2022 coalition deal: Ben-Gvir got expanded National Security Ministry with control of police and Border Police in the West Bank.

Oct 2025: Ben-Gvir voted against the first phase of the Gaza deal; threatened to quit if Hamas not 'dismantled politically and militarily' and death penalty not enacted; 'will not be part of a national defeat and eternal disgrace'.

Nov 2023 truce (24 Nov–1 Dec): extension talks failed; Hamas did not provide a list of 10 hostages for another day and fired rockets; Israel resumed; ~137 hostages remained; PMO: committed to war goals.

Jan 2025 ceasefire: 3 phases; Israel killed 19 the morning it took effect; Israel backed extension through Ramadan/Passover, Hamas rejected 1 March and demanded phase two; Israel halted aid 2 March (Egypt, Qatar, UN: violation), cut electricity 9 March; 18 March strikes resumed — PMO cited Hamas refusal; Netanyahu: 'just the beginning'; UN documented ~1,000 violations attributed to Israel by 19 March.

Oct 2025 ceasefire: by 4 Feb 2026 Gaza health ministry counted 530+ Palestinians killed since 10 Oct 2025; IDF: 4 soldiers killed; Israel struck after militant attack wounded a reservist, calling it a violation.

Netanyahu quoted 'Remember what Amalek did to you' as ground operation began (late Oct 2023); South Africa cited it at ICJ; PMO called genocide charge 'false and preposterous', said it reflects 'deep historical ignorance'; supporters say it referred to Hamas.

1 Sep 2024: bodies of six hostages incl. Hersh Goldberg-Polin recovered; IDF: killed by Hamas shortly before troops arrived; Hostages Families Forum: 'Were it not for the delays, sabotage, and excuses' they would likely be alive; Netanyahu: 'whoever murders hostages doesn't want a deal'.
